# Nexus UI
> Animated React Components & Next.js Templates

Nexus UI is a premium UI component library offering 200+ animated React components, 301 animated icons, production-ready Next.js templates, and copy-paste UI blocks built with Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and TypeScript. Designed for developers shipping SaaS products, landing pages, and marketing sites faster.

## Product

- [Components](/components): 200+ animated React components including motion effects, 3D, backgrounds, cards, forms, and navigation
- [Blocks](/blocks): Production-ready UI blocks for Next.js landing pages — hero sections, pricing grids, testimonials, CTAs
- [Templates](/templates): Full-page Next.js templates for SaaS — animated landing pages, pricing flows, and dashboards
- [Icons](/icons): 301 animated React icons (75 free, the rest Pro: every icon can be previewed and played, Pro unlocks code and sound), each one self-contained file built with Framer Motion, with its own synthesised sound, a live playground and four real-interface examples of where it fits; copy one file, no dependencies beyond Framer Motion
- [Icon sounds](/icons/sounds): how to add the icons' sounds to a project: a dependency-free sound engine, a per-icon score, one function call
- [Videos](/videos): Product videos in 9:16, 1:1, 16:9 and more (launch, pricing, changelog, walkthrough, app store preview, logo bumper, hero loop, teaser) as React components with their own soundtracks; edit the copy live, then take the prompt, source and a script that renders MP4
- [Every component](/llms-full.txt): One line per component, free and Pro, with its install name, in a single plain-text file
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free tier available; Pro plan unlocks premium components and templates

## Documentation

- [Installation Guide](/docs/installation): How to install and set up Nexus UI in a Next.js project
- [Video tutorial](/docs/video-tutorial): A captioned video of the whole setup in VS Code, with every command
- [Install Next.js](/docs/install-nextjs): Step-by-step Next.js setup
- [Install Tailwind CSS](/docs/install-tailwindcss): Tailwind CSS configuration guide
- [Add Utilities](/docs/add-utilities): Adding utility functions and helpers
- [Icons docs](/docs/icons): Copy an animated icon into a React project, props, looks, speed and sound
- [Videos docs](/docs/videos): Render a Nexus video to MP4 with Playwright and ffmpeg
- [CLI Usage](/docs/cli): Using the Nexus UI CLI to add components via shadcn
- [Compare libraries](/alternatives): Nexus UI next to Magic UI, React Bits and Aceternity UI
- [MCP server](/mcp): Connect Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code or Codex to https://www.nexus-ui.com/api/mcp to search components and add them by name (free without a key; Pro with an API key)
- [Claude Code](/claude-code): Install Nexus UI items with the shadcn CLI and use Pro build prompts with AI coding tools

## Blog

- [Blog](/blog): Guides on motion design, Tailwind composition, and shipping SaaS landing pages

## Technology Stack

- Framework: Next.js (App Router)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Animation: Framer Motion
- Language: TypeScript
- Registry: shadcn/ui compatible (`npx shadcn@latest add https://www.nexus-ui.com/r/<component>.json`)
